_note: Popup flows for e2e/04-alternative-payments/popups.spec.ts, hand-written from the SDK sources (no sandbox access). Each flow is keyed on the intent's customer_id (popups_paypal_user / popups_klarna_user / popups_plaid_user). PayPal: wallet/paypal with payment_experience invoke_sdk_client + a paypal session token makes the SDK load the PayPal JS (src/Payments/PaypalSDK.res) and wire paypal.Buttons (src/Payments/PaypalSDKHelpers.res); createOrder confirms and gets the order id from connector_transaction_id (next_action invoke_sdk_client). Klarna: pay_later/klarna with invoke_sdk_client + a klarna session token renders the Klarna Payments express button (src/Payments/KlarnaSDK.res). Plaid: open_banking/open_banking_pis; confirm answers next_action third_party_sdk_session_token (wallet_name open_banking) and the SDK opens the plaidSDK fullscreen frame (src/Payments/PlaidSDKIframe.res), which loads Plaid Link. The vendor scripts (paypalSdkScript, klarnaSdkScript, plaidLinkScript) are minimal stand-ins that reproduce only the vendor API shape and the window they open; the pages they open are stand-ins too. The plaidSDK fullscreen frame's force-sync retrieve goes to GlobalVars.backendEndPoint (https://beta.hyperswitch.io/api), not the merchant's custom backend; the engine strips that /api prefix, so the base retrieve route answers it.
